Jiayuan Zhang 👋

🚀 Founder & CEO @ Multica | 🤖 AI-native Builder

Your next 10 hires won't be human. Building the platform to make that happen.

I build tools that integrate AI agents as real team members. Multica is an open-source platform where coding agents work alongside humans—assigned tasks, reporting progress, and shipping code just like any other colleague.

Current Projects

  • 🧠 Multica — Open-source platform for managing mixed human-agent engineering teams
  • 🦀 andrej-karpathy-skills — Skills from the legendary Andrej Karpathy
  • ⌨️ roam-vim-mode — Vim mode for Roam Research

Legacy Projects

Things I built in the past. Some might still be useful:

  • 🐍 gptlang — A new programming language implemented by GPT-4
  • 📚 programmer-soft-skills — 程序员的软技能
  • 🧠 readbuidl — Read to build
  • 📖 practical-python-programming-cn — Python 实用教程中文翻译

🛠 Tech Stack

Languages

🌱 What I'm Doing

  • Building Multica — Making AI coding agents real teammates, not just tools
  • Exploring agents — How autonomous systems change software development
  • Reading — Papers on LLM reasoning, agentic workflows, and system design
  • Writing — Sharing learnings on AI-native development (coming soon)

📫 Connect

  • 🐦 Twitter/X: @jiayuan_jy

💡 Random Facts

  • Believe in shipping fast over perfect
  • Coffee > Tea (fight me)

⚡ Ship fast. Learn faster.
